items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: I first went to By Road School down at... Durbany and Governor Nicholas. Well, they used to call it By Road Street then, back in those days, you see?

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Yeah. And where did you go to school here?
Yeah. The Robertson School. The Robertson School. I first went to By Road School down at... Durbany and Governor Nicholas. Well, they used to call it By Road Street then, back in those days, you see?
Governor Nicholas was called By Road?
